profiles.title: Workspaces
profiles.description: Each workspace keeps its own library, settings and device connections. Open several at once; switching closes the current window normally.
profiles.newDescription: Choose an empty directory. Its first launch opens Setup and creates a separate device identity.
profiles.existingDescription: Use the selected data in place, preserving its identity, pairings and path mappings. No files are copied or moved.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.removeConfirm: Remove the registration for “{{name}}”? Its directory and all files will remain, and can be added again.
profiles.environment: The current directory was selected by a launch environment variable. Register it and make it the default to use it from an ordinary Bakabase launch.
profiles.switching: Switching workspaces. This window will close normally.
profiles.upgrade: These workspaces share this installation. Close its other workspace windows before updating.
profiles.error.save: The operation did not complete. Please retry.
